description: List the biomedical ontologies BioPortal carries — acronym, full name and type — so you can pick the right vocabulary acronym before searching or looking up a class. AUTHORITATIVE catalogue of what is available in BioPortal. Pass `filter` to narrow by acronym or name substring.

_apiKey.description: Your own BioPortal API key (free, https://bioportal.bioontology.org/accounts/new). Optional — without one the call uses a shared key that NCBO rate-limits across all of its users.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring of the acronym or name (e.g. "snomed", "cancer")

name: bioportal_ontologies
title: Bioportal Ontologies
